objective: B310, G1 with G18 and G17. On recorded sources, fresh drawn starts and the four benchmark constructions, find the first stage whose sharing pattern fails the operator test, bounds on the least number of shared distinctions whose removal restores it, and which closed parity parts admit a signed reading. title: The operator test as a yes-or-no reading of growth
